profile.headline: Software Engineer | AI Developer Experience | React • TypeScript • AWS | AI Coding Assistants | Developer Education | Engineering Enablement
profile.summary: Software Engineer with 7+ years building software, including hands-on experience before and during the rise of generative AI. I combine engineering with developer education and technical communication, and I have added AI-assisted development to that toolkit through hands-on work with agentic coding assistants and workflows.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Build and maintain internal platform UIs using React and TypeScript.
• Develop and maintain unit tests using Vitest/Jest to support reliability and maintainability.
• Work within Jenkins-based CI/CD workflows, monitoring automated pipeline runs and troubleshooting failures as needed.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, production-ready internal tools and improve developer workflows.
• Design and facilitate technical learning experiences focused on AI-assisted software development, including AI coding assistants, agentic workflows, effective prompting, and structured development practices.
• Develop guidance for AI coding assistants, with deeper curriculum development experience in Windsurf/Devin and Copilot, and hands-on use of Claude Code and Gemini in software development and developer education.
• Deliver onboarding sessions and technical workshops for engineers on full-stack development and modern engineering practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer & Curriculum Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and maintained instructor-led software engineering courses primarily for Capital One Developer Academy (CODA), with additional content developed for the Tech Summit and the Tech Early Internship programs.
 • Developed learning modules that guided developers through building working full-stack applications using Python, JavaScript, SQL/NoSQL, TDD, debugging, AWS, and CI/CD.
 • Partnered with instructional teams and technical stakeholders to align curriculum with engineering standards, enterprise technology stacks, and developer workflows

positions.title: CODA Instructor
positions.description:
• Delivered immersive, full-stack engineering instruction within CODA, an internal program designed to help developers new to the field transition into software engineering.
 • Facilitated daily live coding, project-based learning, and pair programming across JavaScript, React, Node.js, SQL, and core engineering practices.
 • Translated complex technical concepts into clear, engaging instruction while adapting to learner needs through continuous feedback and performance data.
 • Mentored hundreds of developers across multiple cohorts, supporting technical growth, project development, and career readiness.
 • Trained and supported new instructors through shadowing, co-teaching, mentorship, and facilitator resources, helping maintain consistency across classrooms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained front-end web applications using Angular/TypeScript
 • Developed reusable UI components and layout templates in collaboration with mid- and senior-level engineers.
 • Rapidly adopted Angular after joining the team and contributed to production development within a new technology stack.
 • Created technical documentation and UI guides to clarify application structure and support future contributors.

positions.title: HRIS & Training Coordinator
positions.description:
• Supported the internal Learning Management System (LMS) for more than 1,100 retail locations nationwide.
 • Created and maintained training resources and reports, and supported users with LMS and training needs.
positions.insights: Skills: Axure RP · Prototyping · Microsoft Office · Learning Management Systems · Front Office Operations

positions.title: HR Admin
positions.description:
• Provided HR and administrative support in a high-volume environment, including new-hire orientation and training.
 • Analyzed workforce data to support process-improvement initiatives.
positions.insights: Skills: Public Speaking · Kronos · Microsoft Office · PeopleSoft · Human Resources (HR) · Employee Training

positions.title: Records Management Coordinator
positions.description: • Maintained a database of Department of Transportation documentation and trained clients on enterprise software and regulatory requirements.

honors.title: Freeman Asia Award
honors.description: Freeman-ASIA was created to support American college students with financial need who are planning to study in Asia. The program’s goal is to increase the number of US citizens who will have exposure to Asian cultures. Recipients are required to complete a service project to share their experiences with their home communities to further encourage study abroad. Service project proposals are approved prior to travel.
honors.issuer: Issued by Institute of International Education · Apr 2006

organizations.name: Asian Student Union
organizations.position: Secretary, Public Relations Officer · Aug 2007 - May 2010
